## Type of change

- [ ] New or updated content (question, resource, project, case, simulation, lesson, playbook)

## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run lint` and `npm test` pass locally
- [ ] For code or layout changes: `npm run test:e2e` passes, and new routes or interactions have a test
- [ ] I opened the site (`npm start`) and checked the pages I touched, in both light and dark mode
- [ ] New links are `https://`, point to the canonical source, and load in a browser
- [ ] Content is from public sources or my own experience — nothing covered by an NDA or a company's confidential interview material
- [ ] Claims about companies, compensation or interview loops are current and not overstated
